text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp, where we'll spend each
and every
day training hard, begins
today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I have to go to the hospital again? And you, you're something else.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just head over to the campsite. You
know you
don't have to come with me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Tosen Jordan gets her toenails
examined
and picks up her medicine, we
meet with
everyone at the camp.
